{"code": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the data
data_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(data_path)

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)

# Filter for severe disease
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = df_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the raw result for transparency
print(mean_biomarker_severe)

# Round to one decimal place for final reporting
rounded_mean = round(mean_biomarker_severe, 1)
print(rounded_mean)"}
